calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26') AND fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(r.refund_net) as total_refunds
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as sales_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(r.refund_net) as refund_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fiscal_year,
    s.fiscal_week,
    COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) as net_sales
  FROM sales_data s
  LEFT JOIN returns_data r ON s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week = r.fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_week,
  net_sales
FROM combined
ORDER BY fiscal_week, fiscal_year

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as sales_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    SUM(r.refund_net) as refund_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fiscal_year,
    s.fiscal_week,
    COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) as net_sales
  FROM sales_data s
  LEFT JOIN returns_data r ON s.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year AND s.fiscal_week = r.fiscal_week
),
pivot_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fiscal_week,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) as sales_fy2024_25,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as sales_fy2025_26
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY fiscal_week
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_week as week,
  sales_fy2024_25 as sales_last_year,
  sales_fy2025_26 as sales_this_year,
  ROUND(((sales_fy2025_26 - sales_fy2024_25) / sales_fy2024_25 * 100), 2) as growth_percent
FROM pivot_data
ORDER BY fiscal_week
